knowledgeDocs.title: Brand Voice & Viral Hook Playbook (2026 IG/FB Algorithm)
knowledgeDocs.content: Instagram & Facebook 2026 algorithm weights Saves 3x and Shares 3x over Likes. Every Reel must open with a concrete 3-second scroll-stopping hook contrasting old expensive tools ($99/mo subscriptions or static image slideshows) against fast programmatic Code-to-Video Reels costing ~₹0.08 via Velona.in. Never use generic listicle hooks like '5 AI Tips'. Always include a single-word Comment-to-DM trigger keyword so the agent can send the Private Reply DM link automatically.

knowledgeDocs.content: Core Offer: AI Automation Blueprint + Ready-to-Use Code-to-Video Agent Templates (₹499 / $19). knowledgeDocs.title: Velona.in Model & Cost Reference
knowledgeDocs.content: Velona.in provides 300+ models via OpenAI-compatible $VELONA_BASE_URL (/v1/chat/completions) and native $VELONA_GATEWAY_URL (/gateway/v1/inference/run & /gateway/v1/inference/embed) with ₹10 minimum UPI top-up. Best value coding model: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash (Coding score 65.0, ₹19.42/1M input, ₹52.12/1M output, ~₹0.08 per Reel). Also supports z-ai/glm-5.3-flash, z-ai/glm-5.3, qwen/qwen3-coder, and google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite.
